title: Kodiak Regional Automation Scoreboard
description: One record per region. Unifies the fragmented localization layer (localization-table-seed, market-languages, store-finder-markets, retailer-frontier-pairs, local-flavor, frontier-gaps) into a single structured shape covering city center, featured frontier, languages+culture, regional design palette (textures/colors/materials), calendar-aware seasonal produce with where-to-buy, in-region retailers, and per-campaign-type fit. Feeds brief composition (target_market -> campaign_message/audience/products) and the local_flavor_for(market,month) island. readiness_score records which fields are populated so a region can be judged ready-to-rock.

region_id.description: Stable slug for the region, lowercase kebab (e.g. park-city-wasatch, las-cruces).

aliases.description: Other market_codes that resolve to the same region (e.g. US-MW-WASATCH + US-MW-PARKCITY-84098 + US-MW-WASATCH-SLC labor shed).

place.description: Human place label as it appears in existing files (e.g. 'Las Cruces + Alamogordo, New Mexico').

classification.description: metro=chain-dense; frontier=rugged but has some retail; frontier-gap=no in-town chain grocer, DTC/subscription only.

city_center.description: The anchor downtown / gathering point the creative can reference.

landmark.description: Signature landmark (e.g. Organ Mountains bench, Park City Mountain base).

featured_frontier.description: The signature local hook -- the single most localized creative angle for this region. This is the heart of the scoreboard.

examples: Roasted Hatch green chile folded into flapjacks, eaten on the Organ Mountains bench
Jensen Farms peach + Copper Moose rhubarb compote on cast iron at the Park City Mountain base farmers market

photo_cue.description: Maps to existing market.cue field and vp-* photography direction.

cross_promo.description: Optional partner activation (e.g. pinonnuts.com, Harley Farms).

consent_status.description: Honor tribal/partner sovereignty -- e.g. Makah fishery is 'maybe, with consent'.

audience.description: Maps directly to brief target_audience + market.audience.

languages.description: Localized languages. Seeded from market-languages.json top_languages.

reason.description: Provenance note for the language selection.

cultural_notes.description: Cultural context beyond language: food traditions, communities, sensitivities. Currently ABSENT in all existing files -- new field.

design_palette.description: REGION-SPECIFIC visual design inputs, distinct from the fixed Kodiak brand palette (bearBrown #3B2316, blazeOrange #E8530E, frontierGreen #1A3C34, parchment #FFF8F0, oatmeal #F4EDE6). These are the local textures/colors/materials that make a region's creative land. Currently ABSENT for nearly all markets -- local-flavor.json is a produce stub with no visual layer.

textures.description: Regional surface/material textures for photo styling (e.g. adobe stucco, weathered pine, red sandstone, kaolin-white clay).

colors.description: Regional accent colors distinct from brand palette. Each is a named local color, optionally with hex.

use.description: Where it appears (sky, produce, terrain, structure).

building_materials.description: Common local architecture/materials for backdrop authenticity (e.g. adobe, ponderosa log cabin, corrugated ranch steel, brick storefront).

landscape_motifs.description: Optional environmental motifs (mesa, alpenglow ridge, artichoke field, kaolin quarry).

seasonal.description: Calendar-aware. Each entry is a holiday-season window (or month) mapping to in-season produce and where to buy it in-region. Reconciles local-flavor.json (month windows) + retailer-frontier-pairs.json (YYYY-MM ingredient calendar).

months.description: Inclusive month integers 1-12; may wrap year end. Matches local-flavor.json month_convention.

pancake_tie.description: How it folds into a Kodiak recipe (e.g. muscadine compote over Power Cakes).

where_to_buy.description: In-region sourcing for the season's produce: chain retailers, farmers markets, farm stands, cross-promo partners.

retailers.description: Chain + local retailers present in region. Seeded from market.retailer string (split) + store-finder-markets. Drives retailer logo lockups and localized-costco/publix briefs.

role.description: home=flagship channel; halo=nearest chain for a frontier-gap; gap-nearest=distant fallback.

distance_mi.description: For frontier-gap markets, distance to this retailer.

campaign_type_fit.description: Fit rating for each of the 7 repeatable campaign types. Every type is scored strong/weak/na with a localized angle. These 7 are the canonical Kodiak campaign taxonomy; existing briefs only partially cover them (see audit).

angle.description: The localized angle for this campaign type in this region.

existing_brief.description: Path to an existing brief that already serves this, if any (e.g. briefs/kodiak-costco.yaml).

readiness.description: Rubric: which scoreboard fields are populated with real data (ready), partial/generic (thin), or missing (absent). score = ready field weight sum / total. ready_to_rock true when no core field is absent.

provenance.description: Where each block was sourced. Keeps the unified record auditable back to the fragment files.
